The '''Gos Hutta system''', also called '''Gos Hutta''', was a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that lay within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area. The system contained three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and several [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and it served as a gateway to the ''Bootana Hutta'', being frequently patrolled by [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The system was used at some point by Hutt clan leaders to meet privileged [[Outlander|foreigners]].

==Description==
The Gos Hutta system, also referred to as Gos Hutta, was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area, a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Gos Hutta lay on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']] that connected it to the [[Mulatan system/Legends|Mulatan]] and [[Varl system/Legends|Varl systems]]. A series of smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes linked the system to the worlds of [[Kor Desilijic]], [[Kor Oktanivii]], and [[Kor Usilic]]. The Gos Hutta system contained three lush [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and multiple [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Similarly to the world of [[Mulatan]], the Gos Hutta system served as a gateway to the ''Bootana Hutta'', with [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] being commonly sighted there,<ref name="TEA" /> including regular patrols by the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Troonol]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Hutt [[Qunaalac]] clan. Anyone wishing to enter the ''Bootana Hutta'' had to traverse the system first, and the warships patrolling the system persuaded travelers passing through from lingering too long.<ref name="LONH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> At some point in Gos Hutta's past, the leaders of Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] clans would summon especially powerful or favored [[Outlander|foreigners]] there,<ref name="TEA" /> meeting them on the space stations in-system.<ref name="LONH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gos Hutta system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and placed the system in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
